Senior Professor Dr. Anelia Hristova and Senior Professor Krasimira Koleva from the Distance Learning, Language Training and Qualification Department took part in the international workshop “Tactical Teaching: Knowledge Sharing Workshops 2025” hosted by the Military University of Technology in Warsaw, Poland.

Associate Professor Valentina Georgieva, PhD carried out teaching sessions with cadets at the General Military Academy (Academia General Militar) in Zaragoza, Spain. The cadets specialized in different military fields such as infantry, logistics, aviation, and engineering. During her lectures, Assoc. Prof. Georgieva presented the online platform helpsec.eu for learning Military English, developed within an international Erasmus+ project.
